alt: 客廳地毯沾著泥腳印與足球，一名大人滿臉通紅、握拳跺腳大喊，另一人驚訝地往後退。
scene_prompt: In an ordinary living room an adult has just discovered a muddy football and muddy footprints on a clean rug. They erupt into a dramatic furious tantrum, face red, eyebrows sharply lowered, mouth open in a shout, both fists clenched beside the torso and one foot stamping hard on the floor. Another adult steps back startled, palms slightly raised; no children being threatened. Clearly exaggerated uncontrolled rage rather than instruction. No thundercloud, no lightning symbols, no hitting, no injury. Anatomically natural body with exactly two arms and legs, no motion duplicates.
